steps.title: Analyze Build Error Logs
steps.description: Inspect the compilation errors and identify incorrect XML attributes in layout file.

steps.title: Verify App Configuration
steps.description: Confirm app metadata and standard options in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Correct Layout Width Error
steps.description: Fix the match_match typo in FrameLayout of activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Fix RelativeLayout Center Attributes
steps.description: Replace invalid android:layout_centerY attributes with android:layout_centerVertical in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Validate Layout XML Schema
steps.description: Ensure all views inside RelativeLayouts are configured with correct attributes.

steps.title: Inspect Java Sources
steps.description: Verify NoteCraft MainActivity.java to ensure it references layout IDs correctly.

steps.title: Verify SQLite Helper Schema
steps.description: Check NotesDatabaseHelper.java for standard SQL compatibility.

steps.title: Confirm Android Manifest Namespace
steps.description: Verify xmlns:android declaration in AndroidManifest.xml matches the correct URL.

steps.title: Verify Build Dependencies
steps.description: Verify the Gradle build script for compatibility with AGP 8.3.2 and Java 8.

steps.title: Building NoteCraft
steps.description: Run clean build with Gradle assembleDebug to produce a working NoteCraft APK.
